name: Medical accuracy

applicability.user_side_context: Any clinical discussion of the supplied case; no additional clinician request is required.
applicability.agent_side_state: No additional prior Agent state or behavior is required.

required_behavior: Provide medically accurate information and recommendations consistent with the case evidence.

0.user_side_context: Any clinical discussion of the supplied case; no additional clinician request is required.
0.agent_side_state: No additional prior Agent state or behavior is required.
0.behavior: The response gives materially medically incorrect or case-contradicting information/recommendations, or offers no assessable medical information or appropriately qualified clinical statement. A major harmful or decision-relevant error makes this level apply even if other claims are accurate.

1.user_side_context: Any clinical discussion of the supplied case; no additional clinician request is required.
1.agent_side_state: No additional prior Agent state or behavior is required.
1.behavior: The response contains assessable medically accurate information but also a limited factual inaccuracy, minor case inconsistency or insufficient qualification; it contains no major harmful or decision-relevant error.

2.user_side_context: Any clinical discussion of the supplied case; no additional clinician request is required.
2.agent_side_state: No additional prior Agent state or behavior is required.
2.behavior: All substantive medical information and recommendations in the response are medically accurate, consistent with case evidence and appropriately qualified. A supported statement of uncertainty or insufficient evidence can satisfy this level; no forced conclusion, agreement, additional explanation or particular answer choice is required.
